summaries: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Engineer specializing in Google Cloud Platform, AWS, and enterprise Kubernetes/OpenShift orchestration. I design zero-trust network topologies, production-grade Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and Ansible, and Python-driven CI/CD pipelines that ship containerized workloads without downtime.

My work spans integrating OpenShift with IBM FileNet and IBM MQ for tier-1 banking, migrating on-prem microservices to GKE, and securing air-gapped GPU clusters for government platforms with a track record of 99.9% uptime across multi-cloud, high-compliance environments.
